Designed for modern living, this exceptional property combines contemporary updates, stylish finishes, and an inviting open-concept layout. The main living area features soaring vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, and abundant natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The spacious living and dining areas provide plenty of room for relaxing and entertaining. The custom kitchen is a true highlight, featuring premium cabinetry, quartzite countertops, a large center island, farmhouse sink, and stainless-steel appliances. The home also offers generously sized bedrooms and beautifully updated bathrooms with quality finishes throughout. Recent improvements include a new roof (2023), updated windows and doors, newer HVAC system, and numerous interior upgrades, providing comfort and peace of mind. Outside, enjoy multiple decks and patio areas overlooking a private, wooded setting-perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing in a peaceful environment. An oversized paver driveway and attached garage provide convenient parking and additional functionality.
